author: Facti0n
body:
Hello, Battle of Stonehenge will spawn you in a small town which is where your monument is located. The other team will also spawn in town on the other side of the map. In the middle of the two towns is Stonehenge. Also, I made a pretty open gap in the middle area because I wanted more sword fights. I didn't want people to just sit behind cover and bow spam.

Details: 

All Screenshots: http://imgur.com/a/RlbtN

The map is 20 versus 20 max. 

Red versus Blue

Each side has one monument

Map Download: https://www.mediafire.com/?bxhj1baakwpll1o

Xml (Not sure if it will work): http://pastebin.com/KmjiSSry
